snippet.title: Hauntsville | PlayStation Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Survive the Cursed West when Hauntsville launches on PlayStation 5 on May 13.

Build a homestead, brave supernatural horrors inspired by American folklore, and fight to survive alone or with friends in this Western horror survival experience.

Wishlist on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016476 
Or play today on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348730/Hauntsville/

Discover more on the indie.io store:  https://store.indie.io/hauntsville
